patch_description:
Introduce two targeted refinements to the ANSATZ_SPEC block:
1) Merge the pre-center and post-center single-qubit Z rotations into a single shared parameter rz_center, enabling parameter sharing across pre- and post-entanglement layers and reducing overall parameter count.
2) Update the descriptive docstring to reflect a clarified structure where center rotations are shared across layers, and ring/hub entanglements remain as before.

These changes are lightweight, stay within EVOLVE-BLOCK constraints, and aim to improve generalization and parameter efficiency without altering the fixed training loop or data/feature map behavior.
